name: Mirroring - New Source: SQL Server 2025
description: Database Mirroring in Fabric provides an easy experience to avoid complex ETL and reflect your entire SQL server 2025 database in Microsoft Fabric. You can continuously replicate your existing SQL Server 2025 data directly into Fabric's OneLake. Inside Fabric, you can unlock powerful business intelligence, artificial intelligence, Data Engineering, Data Science, and data sharing scenarios.
